thread:
ivan: Heads-up: vendor sent a confidential advisory about an HSM firmware integrity bug that can cause attestation blobs to be malformed for certain signing paths (possible supply-chain angle). Customer reported a failed attestation during a BYOK rotate. Need quick operations + RBAC triage.
tara: Can you DM the advisory? Is exploitability known?
ivan: Sent DM. Vendor says exploit requires local operator/console access but we need to assume worst-case until proven. Customer saw mismatch after vendor pushed an update.
mo: Immediate mitigations: 1) disable auto-updates on affected pools, 2) snapshot attestation blobs and export debug audit for Wrap/Unwrap/Sign, 3) prepare rewrap plan to verified HSMs, 4) limit operator entitlements.
ops-bot: ALERT: spike in WrapKey attempts on hsm-prod-1 detected. Incident created #6220000011 :rotating_light:
ivan: RBAC ask: enumerate principals with both WrapKey and ExportKey across regions so we can notify owners and apply a deny policy.
tara: I'll run an IAM scan + correlate with logs. Quick log query I use:
resource.type="hsm_key" protoPayload.methodName="WrapKey" AND protoPayload.request.attestation EXISTS
mo: Add JIT approval for hsm-admin and temporarily remove ExportKey where WrapKey exists. Also tag affected keys for expedited rewrap.
sec-bot: Reminder: run BYOK incident checklist and notify Legal/Compliance if keys protect regulated data. See runbook link (internal).
ivan: Assigning: @tara run principal+wrap scan and upload artifacts to secure vault; @mo prepare RBAC PR and playbook for rewrap; I'll contact vendor and draft customer notice. Post updates here.
tara: Scan complete, DM'd results to Ivan. Found 3 principals with both perms; logs uploaded to secure share. Warroom in 20.
mo: RBAC PR opened with deny-export short-term and JIT for hsm-admin. Adding compatibility note for kms-proxy soft-wrap as fallback.
ivan: Good. If vendor confirms exploitability we'll escalate severity and prepare a full forensic package for affected BYOK customers. Keep this thread updated.
